For more than three years, Benjamin Pawlica has documented the nearly invisible process of mushroom sporulation. “It can only be revealed through carefully controlled backlighting,” he says. Capturing the phenomenon also requires patience: The mushrooms must be mature, and high humidity, little wind, and limited sunlight can help create the right conditions. Here, a cluster of Hypholoma fasciculare releases a dense cloud of spores in France’s Forêts National Park.

12th-century crypt of Verdun Cathedral, France, rediscovered after the Great War during the restoration works. When the reconstruction of the crypt was completed, the cathedral was reconsecrated on 10 November 1935.
